name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's journey into motorsport began as a teenager, tinkering with go-karts in his father's garage in Zagreb. His passion quickly evolved into a pursuit of engineering excellence, leading him to a degree in mechanical engineering and a specialization in vehicle dynamics. Before joining Rahal Letterman Lanigan, Marko honed his operational skills at a smaller European racing outfit, where he oversaw logistics and race-day operations, learning to thrive under pressure and tight deadlines.

As Head of Operations, Marko is known for his meticulous planning and data-driven decision-making. He's committed to optimizing every aspect of the team's performance, from pit stop efficiency to supply chain management. His demanding nature pushes those around him to strive for excellence, but he is also respected for his dedication and willingness to mentor junior team members. Marko is particularly focused on leveraging innovative technologies to gain a competitive edge, making him a valuable asset to RLL.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Marko is of average height with a lean, athletic build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a specific Croatian coffee brand in the team's coffee machine.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
